resources.string: Think Before You Believe. Verify Before You Share.

Enables ContextCheck to provide quick one-tap verification for forwarded WhatsApp messages and media, checking both content and attached context without storing or continuously monitoring private messages.
Allows ContextCheck to detect user-initiated message selection in WhatsApp and verify message context with a single tap.
Displays the subtle ContextCheck verification pill on top of WhatsApp when a message is selected.
Notifies you when deep context comparison and cross-referencing completes.
